
# Security Policy

## Bacus Explorer Security

Security is a fundamental priority of Bacus Explorer.

## Supported Versions

Security fixes will be prioritized for the latest stable release.

Development versions may contain unresolved security issues.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Do not publish sensitive vulnerability details in public Issues.

Use GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting:

https://github.com/ciberspar/bacus-explorer/security/advisories/new

Please include:

- Affected component.
- Affected version or commit.
- General impact.
- Steps for responsible verification.
- Suggested remediation, if known.

Do not include real passwords, private keys, tokens or personal data.

## Security Principles

Bacus Explorer aims to maintain:

- Chromium sandboxing.
- Site isolation.
- Secure credential storage.
- Explicit permission management.
- Safe download handling.
- Secure update procedures.
- Timely security fixes.

## Dependencies

Third-party components retain their original licenses and security requirements.

Chromium security updates must be evaluated and integrated promptly.

## Responsible Disclosure

Please allow the maintainers reasonable time to investigate and
prepare a fix before publicly disclosing a vulnerability.
